title: A/R Summary: without Customers View, customer names are plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access" but not "Customers → View".
  • Have a customer, customer A, with open invoices on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • It is plain text, not a link.

Step 2:

  • Nothing opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R1: “A document number is a link only when the user has the permission to open it and can open it in its own location; otherwise it shows as plain text.”
  • Story 7 Prerequisites: “A customer name on A/R Summary links to A/R Collection for a user with 'Customers → View', as today.”
  • What changes for existing users: “Clicking a row no longer opens it. The document number, or the customer or vendor name on the Summaries, is the link, as on the newer reports (Story 7).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
  • "Signed in to Heavy Duty, the Lethbridge invoices (S3-) are links too." (caption of "Every invoice number is a link")
